title: Multiplicity-Two CM Cycles and the 70D Pfaffian Filter on O(2,4) Period Domains
description: We prove that on the twenty-dimensional O(2,4) period domain of a Calabi-Yau four-fold, the skew-symmetric bivector pairing forces the determinant to equal a perfect square, establishing a positive Pfaffian filter that separates algebraic CM cycles from non-algebraic background glare with multiplicity two. We formalize this decomposition in Lean 4 with zero sorry. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
